name: Recruiter Email Finder
tagline: Works out who does the hiring at your target employers and how to email them
description: You name the companies; it goes after the people who handle campus hiring, graduate intake and engineering roles at each one, and digs out their addresses. Everything arrives as a spreadsheet sorted by employer, so an outreach round becomes a matter of working down a list rather than hunting one contact at a time.
author: fwhittington_24
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
